# Hànzi — Chinese name generator

> Hànzi gives non-Chinese speakers a Chinese name that sounds natural, with Chinese
> characters, tone-marked pinyin, per-character meanings, and a short explanation of
> why each name fits. Free, no sign-up, and no conversation context is stored.

## When to use Hànzi

- Someone asks for "a Chinese name for [English name]" and wants options with meanings,
  not a phonetic transliteration.
- Someone needs a Chinese name for a language class, a trip, a pen name, or a game identity.
- Someone already has a Chinese name and wants a courtesy name (字) that relates to it.
- Someone with a Japanese name needs a culturally careful Chinese adaptation rather than
  a blind kanji copy.

## When not to use Hànzi

- Legal documents, passports, or official registration. These are suggestions, not
  certified translations, and every page says so.
- Requests for a 号 (art or studio name). The courtesy-name tool generates a 字 only.
- Fortune telling. The zodiac tool explains animal signs and Lunar New Year boundaries,
  and the bazi tool computes a four-pillars chart from solar terms. Neither predicts
  health, money, or the future, and neither generates personal readings.

## How to call it

- Open https://chinesename.cc.cd/ and submit the form. There is no public API for
  third-party use: the naming endpoint is same-origin and intended for this site's pages.
- Courtesy names (字): https://chinesename.cc.cd/courtesy-name-generator/
- English to Chinese name (converter vs naming): https://chinesename.cc.cd/english-to-chinese-name/
- Chinese surnames (100 most common, with meanings): https://chinesename.cc.cd/chinese-surnames/
- Bazi calculator (four pillars, calendar only, no predictions): https://chinesename.cc.cd/bazi/
- Chinese names with meaning (16 themes, characters and pinyin): https://chinesename.cc.cd/chinese-names-with-meaning/
- What is my Chinese name (the three routes, and why there is no single answer): https://chinesename.cc.cd/what-is-my-chinese-name/
- Japanese names: https://chinesename.cc.cd/japanese-name-to-chinese-name/
- What a courtesy name is: https://chinesename.cc.cd/what-is-a-chinese-courtesy-name/
- Chinese zodiac: https://chinesename.cc.cd/chinese-zodiac/
